{{Top|leg}}
'''Surface Assault Vehicle''' was a categorization of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Ground assault vehicle/Legends|Ground Assault Vehicle]] classification guide. Surface Assault Vehicles included all ground vehicles that used wheels or treads for movement, such as the [[PX-4 Mobile Command Base]], the [[Compact Assault Vehicle/Wheeled PX-10]], and the various classifications of [[Juggernaut]].
